descriptions.transactions: Search, filter and correct your ledger. Transfers between your accounts stay out of the totals.
descriptions.accounts: Every account starts at zero. Balances add up the activity recorded here, so they show tracked activity rather than what your bank reports.
descriptions.categories: Organize spending and decide how new transactions are filed.
descriptions.payees: Keep merchant names tidy so history and rules stay together.
descriptions.subscriptions: Payments that repeat every month with the same amount.
descriptions.investing: Your Trading 212 portfolio and pies, recorded every hour.
descriptions.chat: Ask questions about your money. Answers come from your ledger; only the question goes to TypeSafe.
descriptions.imports: Bring in CSV exports. Every row is checked before anything reaches your ledger, and nothing is imported twice.
descriptions.settings: Manage your timezone, language, connected services, exchange rates, and workspace status.
